settings.name: smtp_host
settings.description: The address of your SMTP server, such as smtp.hostinger.com. Your email provider lists it with the mailbox settings

settings.name: smtp_port
settings.description: The SMTP port: 465 for a connection that is secure from the start, 587 for one that upgrades to secure

settings.name: smtp_secure
settings.description: Secure from the start (turn on for port 465). Turn off for port 587, which upgrades to a secure connection after connecting

settings.name: smtp_user
settings.description: The username to sign in with, which is usually the full mailbox address such as orders@yourdomain.com. Leave empty for a server that needs none

settings.name: smtp_password
settings.description: The password of that mailbox. Stored encrypted and never shown again
